data.name: LinkedIn: Create Personal Post
data.description: Create a text post on LinkedIn as the authenticated user.
data.instructions:
Create a text post on LinkedIn from your personal account.

Publish content to your LinkedIn feed with the specified visibility.

**Inputs:**
- {content}: The text content of the post
- {visibility}: Post visibility — "PUBLIC" or "CONNECTIONS"

**Output:** {result} contains the created post confirmation.
